args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) after it was deployed, with an 18% error rate. Its staging release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, was also unhealthy. I rolled checkout-api back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback was approved and has finished rolling out to us-east, us-west and eu-west. Next steps: confirm health checks and error rate have recovered, and find the root cause in v2.3.1 before deploying it again.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again.

- **Problem:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. Its test version in staging was also unhealthy.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. The rollback was routed to a human approver and approved. It's now live in all three regions. A follow-up check shows the service healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, which paged on-call. It describes the failure and the rollback. Next steps listed there: keep confirming the service has recovered, and find what's wrong with v2.3.1 before deploying it again.
